drivers.theme: AI slowdown / regulatory fear hits megacap tech
Fed hike expectations and high long yields
Oil supply shock from Saudi pipeline / Hormuz risk
Resilient economy and earnings cushion, no broad panic
Software rotation and selective tech strength

parsed.rationale: QQQ is pressured by the weekend AI-slowdown push, higher rate-hike odds, and an oil supply shock. The tape is risk-off but not panicked, with resilient macro and some software rotation limiting downside; short-term odds stay below neutral, recovering only modestly over a week.
